description: Presidential Secretariat - enlarge the time ending 21st July 2021 by Six months from 21st July 2021 to 21st January 2022 for rendition of the final report on Completion of the tasks assigned to the Commission of Inquiry for human rights
categorisation: The gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Commission of Inquiry Act to extend the deadline for a commission's final report. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it deals with statutory powers, legal timelines, and the functioning of a commission established under specific legislation. While it mentions the President by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or make structural changes to government, but rather focuses on the legal procedural aspect of extending a commission's reporting deadline.
